g.text: docs/ IS the RAG corpus. Edit a spec, and the agent must stop citing the old one.
owns the docs and the git history
owns the vector index and the embedder
github.event.before IS the watermark — no stored state
seed list says project-stage2 (names the FILE)
A delete must target what the INDEX stores, not what
the repo calls it. Mixing the two forms syncs nothing.
what the harness does, in this order
Chunk counts change between versions, so a document cannot
be overwritten in place. Delete first, or old chunks survive.
three modes — the escape hatches matter most
no base, or the seed list changed
A seed change adds or drops EXTERNAL sources a
docs/ diff cannot see — so it escalates.
why a contract, and not one script
Only the public repo can compute WHAT changed — it has the docs and the history.
Only the harness can APPLY it — it has the index and the embedder.
Neither side can do the other's half, so the delta is the seam between them.
